question: Identify the person who was the first to start the individual Satyagraha and was awarded the Ramon Magsaysay Award for Community Leadership in 1958.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinoba Bhave.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Vinoba Bhave was the first person to start the individual Satyagraha.**
 
• The centrepiece of Individual Satyagraha was Non-violence.</li
